characters.name: MIRA
characters.description: Girl, about 10. Small and wiry. Round face, big dark eyes, a gap between her front teeth. Short black bob with a straight fringe and one cowlick sticking up at the back. Oversized striped sweater with sleeves rolled to the elbows, dungaree shorts, scuffed sneakers, a yellow raincoat tied around her waist. Always carries a battered red kite.

characters.name: OTTO
characters.description: Man, late 60s. Tall, thin and slightly stooped. Long face, hooked nose, bushy white eyebrows, round wire glasses, neat white moustache. Bald on top with a fringe of white hair. Fisherman's cable-knit jumper, corduroy trousers, wellington boots, a flat cap. Smokes an unlit pipe.

characters.name: BOLT
characters.description: Dog, scruffy medium-sized terrier mix. Wiry coat, one ear up and one ear flopped down, a dark patch over his left eye, a stubby tail. Wears a too-big red collar with a round tag.

shots.action: A windy seaside cliff at dawn: a lighthouse, a winding path, long grass bent by the wind, gulls overhead.
MIRA runs along the cliff path holding her red kite high, BOLT bounding beside her.
MIRA grins up at the sky, wind in her hair, eyes squinting against the light.
OTTO stands in the lighthouse doorway, pipe in his mouth, shading his eyes with one hand.
MIRA holds out the tangled kite string to OTTO, who peers at it over his glasses.
OTTO raises one bushy eyebrow, amused, the corner of his moustache lifting.
BOLT sits and tilts his head, floppy ear dangling, tag glinting on his collar.
Over OTTO's shoulder: MIRA watches closely as his old hands untangle the string.
All three stand on the cliff edge; OTTO launches the kite while MIRA holds the spool and BOLT barks.
The red kite soars high above the lighthouse against big clouds.
MIRA sits in the grass hugging BOLT, both looking up at the sky.
OTTO smiles softly, taking off his glasses to wipe them.
